name: Web Symbols Liga
about: Web Symbols Liga is a free, open-source icon set with 85 icons designed by Just Be Nice studio. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Web Symbols Liga are there?
faqs.a: There are 85 icons in the Web Symbols Liga set, designed by Just Be Nice studio. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
